name: Example: Serverless AWS Template
content:
ARCHITECTURE & TECHNOLOGY STACK:
- Use serverless architecture with AWS Lambda functions and API Gateway
- Follow microservices pattern with separate services for each business domain
- Use DynamoDB for data persistence with proper table design and GSI optimization
- Implement Node.js/JavaScript for Lambda functions with async/await patterns
- Use AWS SDK v3 with proper error handling and retry logic
- Deploy using Serverless Framework with proper stage management

API DESIGN & PATTERNS:
- Implement RESTful API design with consistent endpoint naming conventions
- Use resource-specific Lambda functions (create.js, list.js, get.js, update.js, delete.js)
- Follow consistent request/response formats with proper HTTP status codes
- Implement proper CORS configuration and security headers
- Use API Gateway request/response validation
- Implement rate limiting and throttling for API protection

DEVELOPMENT PRACTICES:
- Follow test-driven development with Jest for unit and integration testing
- Use ESLint and Prettier for code formatting and quality
- Implement comprehensive error handling with standardized error response formats
- Use environment variables for configuration management
- Follow semantic versioning and proper Git workflow
- Implement proper logging with structured JSON format
- Use AWS X-Ray for distributed tracing

DATA MANAGEMENT:
- Design DynamoDB tables with proper partition and sort keys
- Use Global Secondary Indexes (GSI) for query optimization
- Implement proper data validation and sanitization
- Use DynamoDB Streams for event-driven architecture
- Implement backup and point-in-time recovery
- Follow single-table design patterns where appropriate

SECURITY & PERFORMANCE:
- Implement JWT-based authentication with proper token validation
- Use AWS IAM roles for service-to-service communication
- Implement input validation and sanitization for all endpoints
- Follow performance best practices with connection pooling and caching
- Use CloudWatch for monitoring and logging with structured log formats
- Implement proper secret management with AWS Secrets Manager
- Use AWS WAF for web application firewall protection
- Implement proper encryption at rest and in transit

TESTING & QUALITY ASSURANCE:
- Write comprehensive unit tests with >80% code coverage
- Implement integration tests for API endpoints
- Use mocking for external dependencies and AWS services
- Implement end-to-end testing for critical user journeys
- Use automated testing in CI/CD pipeline
- Implement security testing and vulnerability scanning
- Use performance testing for load and stress testing
